# CozyHub

The all-in-one hub plugin your server deserves. Clean, lightweight, and fully configurable — CozyHub handles everything your lobby needs without the bloat.

## Features

- 🏠 **Spawn System** — Per-world spawns, teleport warmup, teleport on join
- 🌍 **Multi-World Support** — Individual spawn points for every world
- 🖥️ **Server Selector** — Fully configurable GUI navigator with BungeeCord & Velocity support
- 📢 **Join & Quit Messages** — Custom messages with MiniMessage support
- 🎬 **Join Title & Actionbar** — Welcome players with a custom title screen
- 🌟 **First Join Handling** — Special message, starter kit and effects for new players
- 🛡️ **Hub Protection** — Disable PvP, damage, block breaking, hunger and item dropping
- ✈️ **Hub Fly** — Let players fly freely in your lobby
- 🎮 **Hotbar Manager** — Assign actions to hotbar items (open GUI, toggle visibility, connect server)
- 📋 **GUI Navigator** — Fully configurable chest GUI for server selection
- 📊 **Sidebar / Scoreboard** — Animated sidebar with PlaceholderAPI support
- 👥 **Tab List** — Custom header & footer with placeholders
- 🎆 **Join Firework & Sound** — Configurable join effects
- ⬆️ **Double Jump** — Let players double jump with particles and sounds
- 👁️ **Visibility Toggle** — Hide/show other players with one click

## Requirements

| Dependency | Required |
|---|---|
| Paper / Folia 1.21+ | ✅ Yes |
| PlaceholderAPI | ❌ Optional |

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/hub` | Teleport to spawn | `cozyhub.use` |
| `/hub setspawn` | Set the spawn | `cozyhub.setspawn` |
| `/hub reload` | Reload config | `cozyhub.admin` |
| `/vis` | Toggle player visibility | `cozyhub.visibility` |

## Configuration

CozyHub is fully configurable via `config.yml` and `messages.yml`. Every feature can be individually toggled.
